scope: Narrow institutional-source corroboration of canonical original-practice Q6 rail bulk-freight answer; not a 25-MCQ audit

source.title: Improving Rail Efficiency and Share in India's Freight Transport
source.observed: Rail is used for bulk movement of raw materials, with coal, iron ore, cement and other industrial commodities prominent in railway freight; historical 2018–19 data, not current-year modal dominance.

finding: Supports intended railway answer for regular high-volume inland bulk movement, but does not demonstrate that all alternate modes are impossible or that weak distractors are academically discriminating.
limitations: No new option-level validation of all three Q6 distractors
No claim that rail is always optimal for all freight routes or commodities
